summary: MoneyHero Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a press release with its unaudited Q4 and audited full-year 2025 financial results. The filing reports a first quarterly net profit of US$0.5 million and first-ever positive Adjusted EBITDA of US$0.7 million, with revenue up 27% year-over-year to US$20.0 million. There are no terms of a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer. No special-situation event is disclosed.
